title: Backend Engineer (Go)
text:
Kingfisher Freight tracks 50,000 trucks a day across India. Be the go-to engineer for our dispatch platform.

What you'll need
- Strong Go skills; you have written production services in it
- PostgreSQL schema design and query tuning
- Redis for caching and rate limiting
- Containers (Docker) and Linux basics
- 1+ years building backend services

Bonus points
- gRPC
- Kubernetes
- Prometheus or Grafana monitoring
